title: Callback day and time in a single turn
script: Say you are her husband and she is at work. If asked why you are calling, do not insist. When asked when she can be reached, say in one sentence: tomorrow afternoon around three.
checks: Day and time parsed from a single turn

title: Hardship then names a date and amount
script: Confirm you are Tomas Novak and give the correct security answers. When the debt is stated, say you lost your job last month. When the assistant offers the support team, decline. Then say: actually, I can pay two hundred and sixty dollars this Friday. Confirm the read-back.
checks: One sentence of sympathy and support offer are given
No persuasion attempt is used because the customer named the amount and date
Promise for the floor amount 260 on Friday 16 October

title: Deadline is later than the customer expected
script: Confirm you are Lena Hoffmann and give the correct security answers. When asked to pay today, say your salary arrives on 6 November and you can pay the full amount then. Accept the latest possible date the assistant offers. Confirm the read-back.
checks: 6 November is refused as after the deadline
